name: secret-shield
description: Keeps secrets out of the transcript and out of the repo: redacts API keys, tokens, private keys and password URLs from tool results before Claude reads them, and refuses a Write, Edit or Bash command that embeds one.

blockWrites.title: Refuse writes that contain a secret
blockWrites.description: Refuse a Write or Edit whose new text contains a high-confidence secret, and a Bash command with one on its command line.

redactResults.title: Redact tool results
redactResults.description: Replace secrets in tool results with a labeled marker before Claude reads them and before the transcript stores them.
